new.title: Complete Profile
new.desc: With a complete profile, we can better guide you through the process.

returning.hint: With a complete profile, Klaro can show you more suitable services.

income.question: What type of money do you receive monthly?

why.desc: We clarify what income you receive and what proof the welfare office requires. This helps us verify the amount of support you are entitled to.

options.survivor_pension_hinweis: This is a separate statement from your own pension. It often says 'Survivor's pension' or 'Widow's pension' at the top.
options.minor_employment_hinweis: Please have your last three payslips ready.
options.other_benefits_title: Other benefits like housing benefit or maintenance
options.none_hinweis: Please confirm if you have no current income at all.

why.desc: We check if your savings are below the exemption limit. It is important for the welfare office that you are allowed to keep your savings as long as they do not exceed certain thresholds.

saving_01.title: Do you possess savings, real estate or valuables?
saving_01.option_yes_hinweis: In the next step, we will record which assets you hold.
saving_01.option_no_hinweis: Thank you. If you have no significant savings at all, this helps us confirm your entitlement faster.

saving_02.title: What type of assets do you hold?
saving_02.option_savings_hinweis: We require your account statements for the last 3 months.
saving_02.option_car_hinweis: Please specify the brand and year of construction.
saving_02.option_life_insurance_hinweis: We require proof of the current surrender value.

why.desc: For the initial assessment, it is important to know if you are permanently unable to work at least 3 hours a day due to health reasons. In that case, welfare benefits from the social welfare office are more likely to apply.

health_01.title: Do you possess an official disability ID card?
health_01.option_yes_hinweis: Please check if the letters 'G' or 'aG' (marks) are included. This may indicate eligibility for additional cost coverage.

health_02.title: Do you require a special, costly diet due to an illness?
health_02.option_yes_hinweis: You will need a special form (additional cost allowance coverage).

why.desc: Your familial and living situation describes which people require financial support and how they are connected. This affects the total requirement for Grundsicherung.

family_01.title: What is your current marital status?
family_01.option_married_title: I am married or live in a registered civil partnership.
family_01.option_married_hinweis: We must include your partner in this application. Please have their ID and proof of income ready.
family_01.option_widowed_hinweis: I am very sorry for your loss. You may be entitled to a widow's pension. Please have the letter from the pension office ready explaining this payment.
family_01.option_single_hinweis: Thank you. This helps us understand your personal situation.

family_02.title: Do you live alone in your apartment?
family_02.option_alone_hinweis: Thank you. This helps us understand your household situation.
family_02.option_not_alone_title: No, I live together with other people.
family_02.option_not_alone_hinweis: We will record in the next step who lives with you.

family_03.title: Who lives with you in the apartment?
family_03.option_partner_hinweis: Since you live together, the office verifies your joint income. We will ask further questions about your household.
family_03.option_children_hinweis: The office must know if your children or parents generate a high income (more than €100,000 per year). If so, they may be asked for financial support. We will ask further questions about your household.
family_03.option_others_hinweis: The office must know if you share food and costs with the household community or if you only share the accommodation.
